title: False positive warning about mesh not containing tangents
body:
### Tested versions

4.4

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable.mono - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6800 (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.12033.1030) - AMD Ryzen 5 7600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

I have a shader that **writes to** the TANGENT and BINORMAL variables in the **fragment** shader. The vertex shader never accesses these variables at all.

It is triggering this warning:

```
_geometry_instance_add_surface_with_material: Attempting to use a shader (res://voxels/VoxMat.tres::Shader_qe5d5) that requires tangents with a mesh  that doesn't contain tangents. Ensure that meshes are imported with the 'ensure_tangents' option. If creating your own meshes, add an `ARRAY_TANGENT` array (when using ArrayMesh) or call `generate_tangents()` (when using SurfaceTool).
  <C++ Source>  servers/rendering/renderer_rd/forward_clustered/render_forward_clustered.cpp:4055 @ _geometry_instance_add_surface_with_material()
```

Getting rid of the writes to TANGENT and BINORMAL makes the warning go away.

This is wrong. The shader does not depend on mesh tangent data. The logic for this warning is bugged. Alternatively, if the shading system requires meshes to always have tangent data if the TANGENT variable is ever written to, that's also wrong.
